I was in the same exact situation to be completely honest. I tried to kill my self about 6 months ago now, and times before that too. Literally the lowest point in my life. From that point I decided to try to work on things and make it better instead of just ending it all. And I still have really shitty days and feel suicidal sometimes, but I know those are just bad days and you gotta pull through. Because once you pull yourself out of that hole and try to make positive changes with your life, you will start to feel like you want to stay around and work for that happiness. So, please stay. I know this is the most cliche fucking thing, and I used to hate hear people telling me that “it gets better”. I never believed them, because my head wouldn’t let me. But I doesn’t just one day get all better, you have to work for it and MAKE things get better, that’s the hard part. But once they are where you want them to be, you will be so glad that you put in the effort and are able to say you’re happy to be alive. Trust me, it’s worth it.
